integration_issues.issue: Retyping the same query after clearing produced an additional /api/search/universal call instead of returning from cache. Cache code is logically correct; likely either (a) response was empty/null and the cached value was falsy → re-fetch triggered, or (b) effect re-mount. Low priority — debounce already throttles to 1 call per typing burst.

action_items: Optional: tighten commission rounding to paisa instead of Math.round to integer so Test #4 commission shows ₹101.70 rather than ₹102 (spec said ~₹101.70). Final payout ₹898 still matches spec so this is cosmetic.

Optional: investigate why UniversalSearch cache does not short-circuit the repeat-query network call observed in the live test on /printers. Check whether searchCacheSet stores null when response data is empty.

Main agent: live-test on a fresh approved supplier session (a) commission calculator on /supplier with the 4 spec test cases, (b) bulk upload modal grid border visibility, (c) sticky horizontal DealerTabBar look-and-feel, (d) D2D /dealer page for verified dealer (should show spinner, then either listings or gate without flash).
critical_code_review_comments: commission.js commission = Math.round(p * tier.rate) rounds to integer rupees. This loses paisa precision (e.g. 847.46 × 0.12 = 101.6952 → 102 instead of 101.70). If finance reconciliation needs paisa accuracy, switch to Math.round(p * tier.rate * 100) / 100.

Dealer.jsx /d2d/me timeout is 8s. If the endpoint hangs longer, user sees a stuck spinner — consider a fallback to show the gate with a 'temporary issue, please retry' note instead of pure error state.

UniversalSearch.jsx: when API returns an empty object, the cache still stores it, but the Search.jsx parent may want a similar pattern; verify cache is not poisoning subsequent navigations with empty results.
Terms.jsx: renumbering done via hardcoded section titles. Future renumbers will be error-prone. Consider an array-driven section map indexed by number to enforce uniqueness at build time.
BulkUploadGeneric.jsx L91 and L379 duplicate the same className pattern. Extract a shared `cellInputClass(hasErr)` helper to keep both code paths in sync going forward.
